mainEntity.name: Do you use genuine Mercedes-Benz parts for repairs?

mainEntity.name: Is there a warranty on repair work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. All repair, servicing and maintenance work is covered by a 12-month warranty on parts and labour. Terms and conditions apply.

mainEntity.name: Can you collect my car for repair?

mainEntity.name: How do you find the cause of a fault?

acceptedAnswer.text: We start with a full XENTRY scan of every control unit, then follow Mercedes-Benz guided test procedures to confirm the faulty component before recommending a repair, so you only pay to fix what is actually wrong.

Mercedes Engine Repair and Oil Leak Diagnosis On the V6 platforms, it is usually oil cooler seals, camshaft adjusters, and timing components. On the biturbo V8S, it is the turbo oil feed lines and heat management. We always identify the source of the problem before giving you a price for new seals, because leaking oil will burn on the hot exhaust well before it reaches the floor. Explore Service

Mercedes Diagnostics and Fault Finding A fault code indicates where the car detected a fault, but not what caused it. We read every module, test with live data, and perform guided system tests before touching a part. Drivability faults are road tested with live log recording, allowing intermittent symptoms to be captured, not described. Explore Service

Mercedes Transmission and Gearbox Repair A shunt into second gear or shuddering at 40-60 km/h may have five completely different reasons in the 722.9 or 725.0. Fluid levels, adaptation values, torque converter lockup, conductor plate, and the valve body have very different prices. We test-drive with actual data and check the fluid before giving a number. Explore Service

Mercedes AIRMATIC and ABC Suspension Repair An air fault may be a strut, the compressor, the valve block, a relay, or a level sensor, and the test determines whether the bill is four figures or five. We measure the ride height at all four corners and monitor the system as it fills and holds. ABC on the S-Class, CL, and SL is hydraulic and is treated as a separate system. Explore Service

Mercedes AC and Cooling System Repair Cold while driving and warm when stopped is the issue we get called out for most from May to September. We check condenser airflow, cooling fans, compressor control, and charge, then leak-test instead of just regassing. The plastic housings and water pumps crack up from constant heating and cooling cycles, so we also inspect cooling alongside the AC. Explore Service

Mercedes Electrical, ECU and 48V Diagnostics Here, auxiliary battery life is cut in half, and a weak battery will generate multiple unrelated warnings. Test the voltage first so you don't spend money on modules that aren't defective. We fix 48V mild hybrid systems, charging and wiring issues, module communication, keyless go, and MBUX or COMAND diagnostics. Explore Service

mainEntity.name: How much does Mercedes-Benz service cost in Dubai?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on the job. Labour starts from AED 49 for electrical work and from AED 99 for maintenance, mechanical, engine, AC and alignment work. mainEntity.name: Which Mercedes-Benz models do you work on?

mainEntity.name: Will I get a written quote before you start work on my Mercedes-Benz?

acceptedAnswer.text: Always. We diagnose first, send you a written quote, and only go ahead once you've approved it. The price you approve is the price you pay at collection.

mainEntity.name: How often should I service my Mercedes-Benz in Dubai's climate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your car's ASSYST PLUS system tells us whether Service A or Service B is due. We follow the manufacturer's intervals, adjusted where Dubai's heat and driving conditions call for it, and we tell you exactly what's due at your visit.

acceptedAnswer.text: BavarLand is an independent Mercedes-Benz service center and workshop in Dubai Investments Park 1 (DIP 1). Message us on WhatsApp or call +971 4 572 3084 to book an appointment. We work Mon–Sat 10:00–19:00.

mainEntity.name: Do you only work on Mercedes-Benz, or other brands too?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mercedes-Benz is one of our specialist German makes, alongside BMW, Audi, Volkswagen and Porsche. We also service other European makes, including Maserati, Land Rover, Jaguar, Volvo and Skoda, as well as American cars.
